title: Bob Lazar at MIT, possibly placed for defense work
summary: Eric Weinstein tells of Bob Lazar at MIT, possibly placed for defense work, about early 1990s or before at MIT, Lincoln Labs or Draper, Massachusetts, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
place_text: MIT, Lincoln Labs or Draper, Massachusetts

tellings.quote: I I don't know, but my sense is he was put there to work on um something defense related.

tellings.difference: Lazar tells it firsthand and says flatly that he was sent there, putting it before 1988, where Weinstein only guesses and places it in the early 1990s.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Bob Lazar being placed at MIT for classified or defense work. Here Lazar says it himself; in the story Weinstein guesses it.

as_told.title: Sent to MIT for classified work
